raw: XP is not the same thing as money
text: XP is not the same thing as money

raw: Credits buy things. XP is the record of what you have done, and it is what the season rewards read. Every raid pays XP whatever else happens: forty for going at all, four for every container you open, and more the further you walk. Dying pays half of that and backing out pays a quarter. Selling salvage at the terminal pays XP on top, which is why the walk to the terminal is worth making, but it is not the only thing that pays. The Peddler out in the field pays cash and no XP, so what he really sells you is the certainty of getting SOMETHING out.
